meters.title: Select Meters
meters.description: Select the meters you want to track. At least one meter must be selected.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your credentials for {username} have expired. Please enter your password to re-authenticate.

error.no_meters: At least one meter must be selected

init.title: Configure Options
init.description: Costs for billed days come from your MyTPU bills. Optionally pick an entity holding your current price (per kWh for power, per CCF for water) to estimate costs for days since the last bill.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Replaces the usage statistics with all history MyTPU still has (about two years), then rebuilds cost statistics from your bills.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The Tacoma Public Utilities entry to import history for.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Only import from this day on. Leave empty to import everything MyTPU returns.
